一个大浪直朝我们冲过来。

火车轰鸣着驶过车站，没有停。

grammar.f: 主语 + had + 过去分词
grammar.d: 表示在过去某一时刻之前已经完成的动作或状态 用于描述两个过去的动作，先发生的动作用过去完成时，后发生的动作用一般过去时
ex: Both men had hardly had time to realize what was happening when they were thrown into the sea.
两个人还没来得及意识到发生了什么，就被猛地抛入海中。
They had just begun to swim when they noticed the speedboat was moving in a circle.
他们刚开始游泳，就注意到快艇正在绕圈移动。

grammar.f: had just enough time to + 动词原形
grammar.d: 刚刚有足够的时间做某事 强调时间勉强足够，含有紧迫感
ex: They had just had enough time to swim out of danger when the boat again completed a circle.
他们刚刚有时间游出危险区，快艇就又绕了一圈。

grammar.f: Before long, + 主语 + 动词...
grammar.d: 不久，很快 用于描述不久之后发生的事情，语气较正式
ex: Before long, the noise dropped completely and the boat began to drift gently.
不久，声音完全消失，小船开始轻轻漂流。

patterns.p: Both + 主语 + had + 过去分词 + when + 过去时态句子
o: Both men had hardly had time to realize what was happening when they were thrown violently into the sea.
两个人几乎没时间意识到发生了什么，就被猛地抛入海中。
im: Both students had finished the exam when the bell rang.
铃声响起时，两个学生已经答完试卷了。
Both tourists had lost their way when it started to rain heavily.
天开始下大雨时，两个游客已经迷路了。

patterns.p: 主语 + had just + 过去分词 + when + 过去时态句子
o: They had just had enough time to swim out of danger when the boat again completed a circle.
他们刚刚有时间游出危险区，快艇就又绕了一圈。
im: She had just closed the door when the telephone rang.
她刚关上门，电话就响了。
The children had just sat down when the teacher entered the classroom.
孩子们刚坐下，老师就进了教室。

patterns.p: Before long, + 主语 + 动词
o: Before long, the noise dropped completely and the boat began to drift gently across the water.
不久，声音完全消失，小船开始在水面上轻轻漂流。
im: Before long, the storm stopped and the sun came out.
不久，暴风雨停了，太阳出来了。
Before long, he realized his mistake.
不久，他就意识到了自己的错误。

patterns.p: 主语 + 动词 + in + 时间段
o: In less than a minute, it roared past them only a few feet away.
不到一分钟，它就在几英尺外呼啸而过。
im: In two hours, we reached the destination.
两个小时后，我们到达了目的地。
In a few seconds, the light went out.
